conviction_note: A small positive lean (p_up 56 on a 2.8% scale, giving +0.34). The H1 beat over a deliberately low H1 plan is certain but can already be computed from the Q1 tanshin. The company's record of upward FY revisions with matching dividend raises, plus a new 50% total-return policy whose buybacks have not started, gives a modest upside skew. Past Q2 'beat' prints moved only +0.6% to +1.9%, and the January 2026 beat-and-raise was sold 4.2%, so the reaction function keeps p_up close to 50. impact_sum (+0.8) is larger than the scaled number because each finding is sized on its own, and the dividend part of F3 is conditional on F2.
bar: Company H1 plan (26.04-09): revenue 19,000m, OP 500m, ordinary 650m, net 100m; FY revenue 40,000m, OP 2,000m, ordinary 2,850m, net 1,950m, dividend 61 yen (interim 30). Source: FY2026 決算短信 https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260427/140120260424510558.pdf, repeated unchanged in the Q1 短信 https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260729/140120260729501630.pdf. There is no street bar: kabuyoho shows no analyst consensus (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6382), and I could not reach 四季報. print_vs_bar_pct is H1 revenue against the 19,000m plan (Q1 9,017m plus a Q2 of about 9.5-10.5bn). On profit the H1 plan will be beaten by roughly 60-100% (Q1 alone delivered 89% of H1 ordinary), but the market knows that, so I used the less misleading revenue line. With no street bar, every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed, unchanged, as of 2026-10-27 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). kabutan margin data (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6382): margin short 0.0, margin long 159.1k shares at 10/23, up from 149.9k at 9/25. That is about 1% of the 16.14m shares outstanding ex-treasury and roughly 9 days of the ~18k-share daily volume. The name is 制度信用 buy-only, so 信用倍率 is undefined. There is no squeeze fuel, and the modest leveraged long has to sell eventually. There is no skew in Japan. Run-up is -1.96% over 20 days and 0.0% over 5 days. priced_lean_pct is +0.098.

findings.finding: H1 actuals will beat the company's deliberately low H1 plan by a wide margin, so a 業績予想との差異 notice will come with the release. Q1 alone delivered OP 389m (78% of the 500m H1 plan), ordinary 576m (89% of 650m) and net 209m (209% of 100m). The company has beaten its H1 OP plan in each of the last three years: +93% in 2023, +42% in 2024 and +47% in 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: From daily closes. 2025-10-31 (H1 beat of +47% OP vs plan, plus an FY raise): +0.34% on the day and +0.25% the next. 2024-10-31 (H1 beat of +42% OP, variance notice only): +1.99% the next day. 2023-10-31 (H1 beat): +3.93% on the day, then -3.58% the next. Muted, and mixed in sign.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced, which is why it is sized small. Anyone can compute it from the Q1 短信. The release adds the size of the beat and kabutan's headline. That headline will read as a yoy decline: H1 ordinary of about 1.1-1.3bn against 1,816m last year. If the market were pricing a disappointment, the stock would have sold off into the print. Instead it is flat at 1,199, a 5.1% yield and PBR 0.57.
findings.independence: Prior variance notices show the habit: https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20251031/140120251028580048.pdf (2025) and https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20241031/140120241030506005.pdf (2024). Same issuer, different documents.

findings.finding: The FY plan (OP 2,000m, -37%) is called '保守的な見込み' in the company's own results presentation. The company has raised its FY forecast at Q2 in 2025 (+200m OP), and at Q3 in each of the last three years. Q1 OP progress of 19.5% of the FY plan matches the 14.5-19.8% Q1 share of actual FY OP in the prior two years, so the FY plan looks achievable but is not obviously forced upward at this print. I put the chance of an upward FY revision today at about 40%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: From daily closes. FY raise at Q2 2025-10-31 (+200m OP, +2 yen dividend): about +0.6% over two sessions. FY raise at Q3 2026-01-29 (+400m OP, +6 yen dividend), after a run-up to 1,352: -4.22%. 2024-01-31 raise: +3.32%. 2026-04-27 weak guide (-37%) with a higher payout policy: +3.18% / +3.55%. Guidance surprises have moved this stock 3-4% either way.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no analyst coverage and no consensus (kabuyoho shows none), so the price holds the company plan at PER 9.9. If a raise were priced, the stock would trade above its April-July range on the forward PER. Instead it sits at 1,199, near its 20-day low, with a -2% run-up.
findings.independence: History of revisions: https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20251031/140120251028580047.pdf and https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260129/140120260127538926.pdf (same issuer, separate documents).

findings.finding: From this interim dividend the new shareholder-return policy applies: total return of 50% or more including discretionary buybacks, and DOE of at least 3.0% (was 40% / 2.5%). The mid-term plan budgets 70億 of returns over five years, roughly 14億 a year against about 10億 of dividends, which implies buybacks. None has been done since 2022. The dividend is tied mechanically to net profit: 61 yen is 50% of the 1,950m net plan. The company raised its dividend alongside each of its last two FY upgrades.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-01-29 return-policy change with a dividend raise: +10.47% on the day. 2026-04-27 policy change to 50%: +3.18% on the day, +3.55% the next. Return announcements are the largest positive movers in this name's record.
findings.why_not_priced: The policy is public; whether a buyback or a dividend raise comes at this print is not. If the market expected one today, the stock would have run up into the print. It is flat over 5 days and -2% over 20. The dividend half overlaps with F2, so it is sized only for the buyback optionality plus a residual.
findings.independence: Mid-term plan cash allocation (70億 of returns, buybacks included): https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260427/140120260424510569.pdf. Same date and issuer, different document.

findings.finding: The auto-parts segment (about 25% of sales) is deteriorating. In Q1 its sales fell 16.5% and segment OP dropped to 17m from 264m. Toyota's domestic production fell 1.7% yoy in August 2026, so the parts drag probably continued in Q2. Against that, the equipment segment grew sales and OP by 8% in Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-29 Q1, with OP -38.5% and the parts collapse: -1.39% on the day, +1.32% the next. The weakness was looked through.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the parts collapse was in the Q1 短信, and Toyota's production series is public. It lies inside a FY plan the company already built at -37% OP. Net of the larger equipment segment, which grew, it is small.
findings.independence: Toyota August 2026 production (snippet-level, URL has no date path): https://www.logi-today.com/1005493

findings.finding: Margin longs have built to 159.1k shares (10/23), up from 149.9k at 9/25, which is about 9 days of average volume. There are no margin or disclosed shorts. That leaves leveraged holders who would sell a disappointing print, and no short-covering fuel on a good one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-01-29 beat-and-raise after a run-up was sold 4.2%. Not attributable to margin specifically.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is not a fact the market misses, so this is a reaction modifier only and is sized tiny.
findings.independence: JPX short register zero, in the baseline: https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html

outside_window.finding: The mid-term plan implies about 20億 of buybacks over 2026-2030 under a 70億 return budget. If none is announced at this print, the buyback is still pending, with the timing undated.

searched_and_found_nothing: No pre-released 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 for 6382 since 2026-04-27. The kabutan news list (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6382) and the irbank IR list (https://irbank.net/6382/ir) both show the Q1 短信 as the last results item.
No analyst consensus or IFIS figure: kabuyoho reportAnalyst shows none (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6382). I did not reach 四季報.
No 2026 order or contract announcements found via web search (トリニティ工業 塗装設備 受注 2026年).
The company IR calendar page (https://www.trinityind.co.jp/ir/calendar/) does not list a release time. The time is inferred from every disclosure since 2021 being stamped 15:00.

The reason for the H1 net plan of 100m against 650m ordinary is not stated. The Q1 effective tax rate was about 61% (328.7m tax on about 538m pre-tax), which is consistent with a high H1 tax charge rather than a planned special loss. No impairment or special-loss disclosure was found.
release_time_source: https://irbank.net/6382/ir (every 決算短信 and revision since 2021 is stamped 15:00, including 2026-07-29 and 2026-04-27; kabutan also stamps the Q1 item 26/07/29 15:00). Date confirmed as 2026/10/28 on https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6382 and kabuyoho.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: about 40% chance of an upward FY revision. The company calls the plan conservative and raised at Q2 2025, but Q1 progress is normal, not forced. Returns: interim dividend of 30 yen under the new 50% total-return policy; a buyback or dividend raise is possible but unannounced. New-year guide: not applicable (H1 print). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 OP was 19.5% of the FY plan, against 14.5-19.8% of actual FY at Q1 in the prior two years. That is in line, and the H1 plan will be beaten on any plausible Q2.
baseline_tension: What I found leans mildly positive (beat certain, revision and returns possible) and does not conflict with the flat run-up or the near-zero priced lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is an FY raise with a dividend increase or a first buyback under the 50% policy. I looked for it and found only the policy and the history, not a dated announcement. The strongest negative is a held FY plan alongside a yoy-down H1 headline, which a buy-only margin long could sell.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series moves toward 0 / p_up toward 50): cut the auto-parts finding from -0.2 to -0.1, since the parts collapse is in the Q1 短信 and Toyota production is public. p_up was already 56 and is unchanged.
Rule 2 (check the sign): my set is net positive, and I recorded the strongest positive and negative in baseline_tension. Nothing else changed.
